hero.title: One barn,
hero.lede: A 17th-century threshing barn for ceremonies, wedding breakfasts and dancing until midnight, all under one roof. Scroll through a day here, from the empty room to the last dance.

stages.c: Oak beams, a flagstone floor and doors at both ends. The morning is yours to set up.
Cross-back chairs in rows, an aisle of petals and an arch of garden roses at the far end.
A hundred and twenty people find their seats. You walk in through the big doors.
Drinks in the courtyard while our team turns the barn round, every chair to a table, in forty minutes.
Twelve round tables, white linen, candles and flowers from the walled garden.
Festoon lights on, tables to the side, a dance floor in the middle until a quarter to midnight.

spaces.title: Three spaces,
spaces.sub: Marry in the barn or under the old cedar, eat in the barn, drink in the courtyard. Here's how many each one holds.

list.d: Ceremony, dinner and dancing under 400-year-old oak.
Vows outdoors under the old cedar, May to September.
Drinks, canapés and a fire on cold nights.

price.title: Your date,

day.title: How a day here
day.sub: Every wedding is its own, but most follow this shape. Your coordinator will build yours with you, minute by minute.

items.d: Two dressing rooms in the farmhouse, with breakfast sent up.
In the barn, or on the lawn under the cedar.
Canapés in the courtyard while we turn the barn round.
Three courses at the long tables, speeches with pudding.
First dance, festoon lights and the bar open late.
Last orders at 23:15, sparklers on the drive at the end.
